fields.question: Does the bidding company itself state that it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence? false if the electrical work is left to a subcontractor or a licence still to be obtained; null if the proposal does not say.
The Ontario ECRA/ESA licence number exactly as written, or null.
Does the proposal confirm current WSIB clearance? null if not mentioned.
Liability insurance amount in CAD as a plain number (for example 5000000). null if not mentioned.
How many completed commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more does the bidder state? Use only the number written in the proposal; do not estimate.

The earliest year that project count covers. 'since 2021' gives 2021; 'in the past four years' gives the evaluation year minus 4; 'in the last five years' gives the evaluation year minus 5. null if no period is given.
Total all-in price in CAD as a plain number. null if no single total is given.
Committed completion time in weeks from award. null if the schedule is not committed (for example 'to be determined').
Does the proposal commit a named or specifically identified project lead? false if the lead is only 'to be assigned'.
Does the proposal describe the installation crew (size and/or certification)?
Does the proposal include a site safety plan?
Does the proposal include system performance monitoring after installation? Construction progress reports do not count.

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by bidder

window.note: project count may include installs older than 5 years
